problem.title: Minimum Adjacent Swaps for K Consecutive Ones
problem.problemStatement: Given a binary array and an integer K, determine the minimum number of adjacent swaps required to group K ones consecutively.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and K. • Second line contains N binary integers.
problem.output: Print the minimum number of swaps.
